headline: S&P 500 Eyes Records, Fed Hike Odds Near 51% Before CPI: Stock Market Today
summary: Crude rebounds and small caps outperform while megacap tech drags the Nasdaq lower, as traders brace for Wednesday's U.S. inflation print and even odds of a Fed hike.

headline: Phillips 66, Kinder Morgan, HF Sinclair Approve $5B Pipeline Project
summary: Phillips 66 shares rise after Western Gateway reaches investment decision, with the $5B pipeline targeting 230,000 barrels per day capacity.
